items.t: Did Record Special Dividend Just Shift Costco Wholesale's (COST) Investment Narrative?
items.sum: Costco Wholesale declared a special cash dividend of $30 per share, totaling about $13.3b, payable on December 4, 2026, and paired it with a new $4b share repurchase authorization running through November 2030. The one time payout and refreshed buyback highlight the extent of the excess cash Costco Wholesale is generating in addition to its regular reinvestment needs and ongoing membership focused
